answer: Bounty bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and posts a 30-credit bounty on its own head, listed on the ivory tally. A falcon auditor proving a fake claims the 30 bounty; the 70 bond burns. A gale audit sweeps a tenth of identities each epoch. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 100, 100,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Bounty-farming fails: a false claim burns the claimant's 30. Honest agents post 30 once, bond kept.
